scope: Mugar west block, lower two-storey south window wall only; no upper-facade or footprint replacement

sources.supports: Large plate-glass lower windows, narrow vertical upper windows and deep projecting concrete sun fins on the south/east elevations.

sources.author: Pi.1415926535
sources.modifications: None; original image retained as an architectural reference, not used as a game texture.
sources.supports: South lower window wall has thin but deep upright concrete blades, shorter lower hanging tails and a horizontal intermediate band. Glazing is behind this screen, not at its outer edge.

sources.rights: Boston University published reference photograph; not a runtime texture or a claim of open licensing.
sources.supports: Mugar edge beside the shared Link has exposed-aggregate concrete, deep fin returns and pale metal glazing frames.

sources.rights: Klopfer Martin Design Group published reference; not a game texture or a claim of open licensing.
sources.supports: Context reference only: photograph depicts the Bay State Road side and was not used to infer the south elevation geometry.

implementation.integration: scene-assets-desktop.ts and mobile-campus.ts add this bounded module after existing shells; their model traversal owns disposal.
implementation.southBoundary: Derived from the retained mugar-west GIS-clipped footprint through BU_SERT_FRAME; no source footprint vertices are moved.
implementation.datum: Existing BU_SERT_FOUNDATION_ANCHOR sampled by buElevation; local geometry is not terrain-warped.
implementation.grid: Each existing primary curtain-wall bay is split in two, keeping old upright axes aligned. This is an authored fit, not a claimed measured bay count.
implementation.glass: New opaque PBR panes sit in front of the existing old curtain glass and behind its structural frame. Borrow the established sky-reflection material; no new texture/probe, interior or building reflection.
implementation.collision: No new ground or wall collider. The inherited building wall remains closed and the projecting screen starts above pedestrian head height; the shared Link door corridor stays clear.
implementation.mobile: Same geometry and object positions, light mobile sky reflection. Added after mobile HD material discovery so switching low/HD retains the dedicated material. No mobile GLB is rebaked.

limits: Fin positions, dimensions, band levels and metal sections are photo-led estimates fitted to the inherited facade rhythm, not as-built measurements.
The upper Mugar facade, remaining east/north/west elevations, GSU and surrounding trees retain earlier models and substantial real-scene differences.
The source south photograph includes trees, bicycle racks, notices and older portal details; this bounded facade pass does not claim to reproduce those or add a new public entrance.
New glass is an opaque exterior representation and does not recreate library interiors; sky reflection is not a live reflection of courtyard trees/buildings.
Technical geometry and collision tests do not establish final real-scene fidelity. Runtime before/after comparison is required.

validation.testResult: 3 targeted test files / 14 tests passed on 2026-10-25.
validation.result: Desktop before and after technical captures passed at two locked camera positions; mobile after passed at 03-mugar-south. Actual visual inspection confirms the new lower screen and recessed glazing at 03, but upper facades remain simplified. The old 04-gsu-front camera is inside the GSU shell in both before and after and is invalid for exterior visual acceptance. It remains recorded for diagnosis, not as a successful exterior comparison.
validation.mobileLimit: Mobile capture runs the mobile resource configuration in desktop Chromium, not an iOS hardware test. Geometry matches desktop, but simplified lighting/reflection produces a flatter result.
